f.title: Treat spontaneous AEs with unknown causality as ADRs unless reporter and company both exclude a link
f.statement: An adverse drug reaction is a harmful, unintended reaction to normal administration or use of a product where a causal relationship cannot be excluded. Spontaneously reported adverse events whose causal relationship is unknown are regarded as ADRs; they are excluded only where both the reporter and the manufacturer/sponsor judge them unrelated to the product.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; ICSR quality control

rows.quote: "약물이상반응(Adverse Drug Reaction, ADR)"이란 의약품등을 정상적으로 투여ㆍ사용하여 발생한 유해하고 의도하지 아니한 반응으로서 해당 의약품등과의 인과관계를 배제할 수 없는 경우를 말하며, 자발적으로 보고된 이상사례 중에서 의약품등과의 인과관계가 알려지지 않은 경우에는 약물이상반응으로 본다. 다만, 보고자와 제조자/의뢰자 모두가 의약품등과 관련이 없다고 판단한 경우에는 약물이상반응에서 제외한다.
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it decides which spontaneous reports count as ADRs. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: binding definition in a regulation, Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: "Adverse drug reaction (ADR)" means a harmful and unintended reaction occurring when a pharmaceutical etc. is administered or used normally, where a causal relationship with the pharmaceutical etc. cannot be excluded; among spontaneously reported adverse events, those whose causal relationship with the pharmaceutical etc. is unknown are regarded as adverse drug reactions. However, where both the reporter and the manufacturer/sponsor judge that it is not related to the pharmaceutical etc., it is excluded from adverse drug reactions.

f.title: Have the safety management officer collect and record safety information from all listed sources
f.statement: The MAH shall have its safety management officer collect, and prepare records of, safety information: reports from physicians, pharmacists etc.; surveys on marketed products; post-marketing clinical trials; information disseminated by MFDS or KIDS; information on foreign safety measures; and other information collected under the pharmacovigilance system.
f.clause: 2. 수집대상 정보 (Information to be collected), 가
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 안전관리책임자로 하여금 다음에 해당하는 안전정보를 수집하게 하고 그 기록을 작성하게 하여야 한다.
rows.location: 2. 수집대상 정보 (Information to be collected), 가
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the operative lead-in; sources 1)-6) summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have the safety management officer collect the following safety information and prepare records of it.

f.title: Safety information may come from unplanned and planned collection systems
f.statement: Safety information may be collected from unplanned systems (spontaneous reports, literature, internet) and planned systems (risk management plans, non-interventional/observational studies, patient support programmes).
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: 가목에 따른 의약품 안전정보는 다음의 정보로부터 수집할 수 있다. 1) 자발적 보고자료, 문헌 자료, 인터넷 수집자료 등 계획되지 않은 수집체계에서 얻은 정보 2) 위해성 관리 계획, 비중재적/관찰 연구, 환자 지원프로그램 등 계획된 수집체계에서 얻은 정보
rows.review_note: Review: 할 수 있다 = may (Permitted). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The pharmaceutical safety information under subitem a may be collected from the following: 1) information obtained from unplanned collection systems, such as spontaneous reports, literature and information collected from the internet; 2) information obtained from planned collection systems, such as risk management plans, non-interventional/observational studies and patient support programmes.

f.title: Maintain the organisation, staff and SOPs for post-marketing safety management
f.statement: The MAH shall have the organisation, personnel, SOPs etc. needed for post-marketing safety management and shall thoroughly carry out collection, evaluation and reporting of safety information and safety measures.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 시판 후 안전관리를 위해 필요한 조직, 인력, 업무기준서 등을 갖추고, 안전성정보 수집, 평가, 보고 및 안전관리조치 등을 철저히 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have the organisation, personnel, standard operating procedures etc. necessary for post-marketing safety management, and shall thoroughly carry out the collection, evaluation and reporting of safety-related information and safety management measures.

f.title: Keep enough trained staff for safety information management
f.statement: The MAH shall have sufficient personnel for safety information management, and those staff shall have received education and training in that work.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 의약품 안전성정보 관리 업무를 원활하게 수행할 수 있도록 충분한 인력을 보유하여야 한다. 이 경우 의약품 안전성정보 관리 업무에 종사하는 자는 해당 업무에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련을 받은 사람이어야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have sufficient personnel to carry out pharmaceutical safety information management smoothly. In this case, persons engaged in pharmaceutical safety information management shall be persons who have received education and training in that work.

f.title: Do not obstruct the safety management officer or refuse their requests without reason
f.statement: The MAH shall not obstruct the work of the safety management officer and shall not refuse, without justifiable reason, requests the officer makes as necessary for the work.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 안전관리책임자의 업무를 방해하여서는 아니 되며, 안전관리책임자가 업무 수행을 위하여 필요한 사항을 요청하면 정당한 사유없이 그 요청을 거부하여서는 아니 된다.
rows.review_note: Review: 하여서는 아니 된다 = shall not (Mandatory). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall not obstruct the work of the safety management officer, and shall not refuse without justifiable reason any request the safety management officer makes as necessary for performing the work.

f.title: Pass all safety information to the safety management officer
f.statement: The MAH shall pass all safety-related information on its pharmaceuticals to the safety management officer.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 의약품의 모든 안전성정보를 안전관리책임자에게 전달하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall pass all safety-related information on the pharmaceutical to the safety management officer.

f.title: Run regular self-inspections of safety management work
f.statement: The MAH shall have regular self-inspections conducted of the safety management work performed under its SOPs.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 업무기준서에 따라 실시한 안전관리 업무에 대하여 정기적으로 자율점검을 실시하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have self-inspections conducted regularly of the safety management work carried out under the standard operating procedures.

f.title: Maintain post-marketing safety SOPs covering duties, collection, evaluation, RMP, measures, records and training
f.statement: The MAH shall have and maintain SOPs for post-marketing safety management covering: duties of safety staff and the safety information management system; scope, methods and procedures of collection; analysis and evaluation; preparation and implementation of RMPs; implementation of safety measures; retention of safety documents; training of safety staff; and other necessary matters.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 시판 후 의약품 안전관리를 원활하게 수행하기 위하여 다음의 내용을 포함한 업무기준서를 갖추고 관리하여야 한다. 1) 안전 관리 업무에 종사하는 자의 책무, 안전정보 관리체계 2) 안전정보의 수집 대상, 방법 및 절차 3) 안전정보의 분석 및 평가에 관한 절차 4) 위해성 관리 계획 작성 및 실시에 관한 사항 5) 안전관리조치 실시에 관한 사항 6) 안전정보 관련 문서의 보관에 대한 사항 7) 안전정보 관리 업무에 종사하는 자에 대한 교육ㆍ훈련 절차 8) 그 밖에 안전관리 업무를 수행하는 데 필요한 사항
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: To carry out post-marketing safety management of pharmaceuticals smoothly, the marketing authorisation holder shall have and maintain standard operating procedures that include the following: 1) duties of persons engaged in safety management work, and the safety information management system; 2) the scope, methods and procedures for collecting safety information; 3) procedures for analysis and evaluation of safety information; 4) matters concerning the preparation and implementation of risk management plans; 5) matters concerning the implementation of safety management measures; 6) matters concerning the retention of documents related to safety information; 7) education and training procedures for persons engaged in safety information management; 8) other matters necessary to carry out safety management work.

f.title: Make the safety officer follow new or revised SOPs and keep related documents
f.statement: When the MAH prepares or revises the SOPs, it shall have the safety management officer comply with them and retain the related documents.

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 업무기준서를 작성하거나 개정하였을 때에는 안전관리책임자로 하여금 해당 업무기준서를 준수하고 이와 관련된 문서를 보존하게 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: When the marketing authorisation holder prepares or revises the standard operating procedures, it shall have the safety management officer comply with those procedures and retain the related documents.

f.title: Carry out and record safety management under the approved RMP
f.statement: For a product with a submitted risk management plan, the MAH shall have the safety management officer carry out safety management according to the RMP and retain the records.
f.clause: 5. 위해성 관리 계획에 따른 안전관리 (Safety management under the RMP), 가
f.applicability: Products with a submitted risk management plan

rows.quote: 위해성 관리 계획을 제출한 의약품에 대하여 품목허가를 받은 자는 안전관리책임자에게 위해성 관리 계획에 따라 안전관리를 실시하게 하고, 그 기록을 보존하게 하여야 한다.
rows.location: 5. 위해성 관리 계획에 따른 안전관리 (Safety management under the RMP), 가
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For a pharmaceutical for which a risk management plan has been submitted, the marketing authorisation holder shall have the safety management officer carry out safety management in accordance with the risk management plan and retain the records.

f.title: Safety officer may propose RMP changes; MAH may change and resubmit the RMP
f.statement: The safety management officer may propose a change to the RMP to the MAH where needed for safe use. Where the MAH receives such a proposal or MFDS requires a risk management change plan, the MAH may change and submit the RMP.
f.clause: 5. 위해성 관리 계획에 따른 안전관리, 나-다
f.applicability: Products with a submitted risk management plan

rows.quote: 위해성 관리 계획을 제출한 의약품에 대하여 품목허가를 받은 자는 나목에 따라 위해성 관리 계획의 변경을 제안 받거나 식품의약품안전처장이 위해성 관리 변경계획서의 제출을 요구한 경우 위해성 관리 계획을 변경하여 제출할 수 있다.
rows.location: 5. 위해성 관리 계획에 따른 안전관리, 나-다
rows.review_note: Review: 할 수 있다 = may. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: the regulation frames the change as permitted even when MFDS requires a change plan.
rows.quote_en: For a pharmaceutical for which a risk management plan has been submitted, the marketing authorisation holder may change and submit the risk management plan where it has received a proposal for change under subitem b or the Minister of Food and Drug Safety has required submission of a risk management change plan.

f.title: Report new safety information or the need for extra safety measures to MFDS with analysis and action plan
f.statement: Where the MAH discovers new safety-related information or judges additional safety measures necessary, it shall report to MFDS attaching: the background, analysis and evaluation results and supporting data; foreign approval particulars and measures taken; and the action plan (with a comparison table and draft change if the approved particulars need changing).
f.clause: 6. 안전성정보의 보고 (Reporting of safety-related information), 라
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Submission operations; Safety labeling

rows.quote: 의약품 품목허가를 받은 자는 안전성과 관련된 새로운 정보를 발견하거나 추가적인 안전대책이 필요하다고 판단되는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 자료를 첨부하여 식품의약품안전처장에게 보고하여야 한다. 1) 해당 안전성정보의 배경, 정보 분석ㆍ평가 결과 및 근거자료 2) 해당 안전성정보와 관련된 의약품의 국외 허가사항 및 조치현황 3) 해당 안전성정보에 대한 조치계획(품목허가 사항의 변경이 필요하다고 판단되는 경우에는 변경대비표 및 변경안을 포함한다)
rows.location: 6. 안전성정보의 보고 (Reporting of safety-related information), 라
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where the marketing authorisation holder discovers new safety-related information or judges that additional safety measures are needed, it shall report to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety, attaching the following: 1) the background of the safety-related information, the results of analysis and evaluation of the information, and supporting data; 2) the foreign approval particulars and status of measures for the pharmaceutical related to the safety-related information; 3) the action plan for the safety-related information (including a comparison table and draft change where a change to the approved particulars is judged necessary).

f.title: Report foreign sale suspensions, recalls or equivalent measures within 3 days
f.statement: When the MAH becomes aware of a sale suspension, recall or equivalent measure (including measures on fatal cases) by a foreign government or foreign authorised manufacturer/importer, it shall report it to MFDS within 3 days of becoming aware, attaching the background, content, characteristics and domestic action plan.
f.processes: Regulatory intelligence; Submission operations; Benefit–risk review

rows.deadline: Within 3 days from the date of becoming aware
rows.quote: 외국정부(외국의 법령에 따라 의약품을 제조ㆍ수입하거나 제조ㆍ수입하여 판매할 수 있는 권한을 가진 자를 포함한다. 이하 이 목에서 같다)의 판매중지, 회수 또는 이에 준하는 조치(사망사례에 대한 조치를 포함한다)에 관한 정보: 해당 정보를 알게 된 날부터 3일 이내.
rows.review_note: Review: split from the 7-day allowance for the domestic action plan. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers. Double-check: Korean day counts read as calendar days.
rows.quote_en: Information on a suspension of sale, recall or equivalent measure (including measures concerning fatal cases) by a foreign government (including a person authorised under foreign law to manufacture or import, or manufacture or import and sell, pharmaceuticals; the same applies in this subitem): within 3 days from the date of becoming aware of the information.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Foreign sale suspension, recall or equivalent measure

f.title: The domestic action plan for a foreign safety measure may follow within 7 days
f.statement: For reports of foreign sale suspensions, recalls or equivalent measures, the matters concerning the domestic action plan may be reported within 7 days.

rows.quote: 다만, 국내조치계획에 관한 사항은 7일 이내에 보고할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: the 7 days run from the same awareness date as the 3-day report (clock wording taken from the main sentence). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: However, the matters concerning the domestic action plan may be reported within 7 days.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Domestic action plan for a foreign sale suspension or recall

f.title: Report serious information MFDS has ordered within 7 days of the order
f.statement: Serious information on pharmaceuticals comparable to a foreign sale suspension or recall, whose reporting MFDS has ordered, shall be reported within 7 days of receiving the order.

rows.deadline: Within 7 days from the date the order was received
rows.quote: 식품의약품안전처장이 보고를 지시한 정보: 해당 보고를 지시받은 날부터 7일 이내
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Information whose reporting the Minister of Food and Drug Safety has ordered: within 7 days from the date the order to report was received.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious safety information whose reporting MFDS ordered

f.title: Report other serious safety information within 15 days of awareness
f.statement: Serious information on pharmaceuticals comparable to a foreign sale suspension or recall, whose reporting MFDS has not ordered, shall be reported within 15 days of becoming aware.

rows.deadline: Within 15 days from the date of becoming aware
rows.quote: 식품의약품안전처장이 보고를 지시하지 않은 정보: 해당 정보를 알게 된 날부터 15일 이내
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Information whose reporting the Minister of Food and Drug Safety has not ordered: within 15 days from the date of becoming aware of the information.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Other serious safety information comparable to foreign regulatory measures

f.title: Report serious ADRs, domestic and foreign, to KIDS within 15 days
f.statement: Under Article 68-8 of the Act, MAHs, pharmaceutical wholesalers, pharmacy founders and medical institution founders shall report serious adverse drug reactions to the President of KIDS within 15 days of becoming aware. The same applies to serious ADRs that occurred abroad.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (also wholesalers, pharmacy and medical institution founders)
rows.deadline: Within 15 days from the date of becoming aware
rows.quote: 법 제68조의8에 따라 의약품둥 품목허가를 받은 자, 의약품도매상, 약국개설자 및 의료기관개설자는 중대한 약물이상반응을 알게 된 날부터 15일 이내에 의약품안전관리원장에게 보고하여야 한다. 외국에서 발생한 중대한 약물이상반응을 알게 된 경우에도 또한 같다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; the source misprints 의약품등 as 의약품둥 (kept verbatim). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Under Article 68-8 of the Act, marketing authorisation holders of pharmaceuticals etc., pharmaceutical wholesalers, pharmacy founders and medical institution founders shall report a serious adverse drug reaction to the President of the Korea Institute of Drug Safety and Risk Management within 15 days from the date they became aware of it. The same applies where they become aware of a serious adverse drug reaction that occurred in a foreign country.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious adverse drug reactions, domestic and foreign

f.title: Submit expedited reports via the KIDS website or Form 77-2 with electronic data
f.statement: Expedited reports under item 7(b) shall be made through the KIDS website, or by post on Form No. 77-2 (including electronic documents) with the related electronic data attached.

rows.quote: 나목에 따른 안전성정보의 신속보고는 의약품안전관리원 홈페이지를 통해 보고하거나 별지 제77호의2서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 관련 전자자료를 첨부하여 우편으로 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Expedited reporting of safety-related information under subitem b shall be made through the website of the Korea Institute of Drug Safety and Risk Management, or by post on Form No. 77-2 (including electronic documents) with the related electronic data attached.

f.title: Report non-expedited safety information to KIDS within one month after each quarter
f.statement: MAHs and wholesalers shall report safety-related information other than expedited reports to the President of KIDS within one month after the end of each quarter, via the KIDS website or by post on Form No. 77-2 with electronic data.

rows.deadline: Within 1 month after the end of each quarter
rows.quote: 의약품등 품목허가를 받은 자 및 의약품 도매상은 가목 또는 나목에 따라 신속보고 된 안전성정보 이외의 안전성정보를 매 분기 종료 후 1개월 이내에 의약품안전관리원 홈페이지를 통해 보고하거나 별지 제77호의2서식(전자문서를 포함한다)에 관련 전자자료를 첨부하여 우편으로 의약품안전관리원장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders of pharmaceuticals etc. and pharmaceutical wholesalers shall report safety-related information other than that reported expeditiously under subitem a or b to the President of the Korea Institute of Drug Safety and Risk Management within one month after the end of each quarter, through the Institute's website or by post on Form No. 77-2 (including electronic documents) with the related electronic data attached.

f.title: If quarterly reporting will be late, give KIDS the expected date and reason
f.statement: Where the quarterly report cannot be made in time for unavoidable reasons, the expected reporting date and the specific reason for the delay shall be submitted to the President of KIDS.

rows.quote: 다만, 부득이한 사유로 해당 기간 내에 보고를 할 수 없는 경우에는 보고예정일과 구체적인 지연사유를 의약품안전관리원장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: However, where the report cannot be made within that period for unavoidable reasons, the expected reporting date and the specific reason for the delay shall be submitted to the President of the Institute.

f.title: For PSUR or PMS-study products, report non-expedited information in the quarter of the report submission
f.statement: For products subject to periodic safety update reporting under item 8 or to separate result reports from post-marketing clinical trials, non-expedited safety information shall be reported within one month after the end of the quarter in which the PSUR or result report submission date falls.
f.applicability: Products subject to periodic safety update reports or post-marketing study result reports

rows.deadline: Within 1 month after the end of the quarter containing the PSUR/result report submission date
rows.quote: 라목에도 불구하고 제8호에 따른 정기적인 최신 안전성정보 보고대상 의약품 또는 시판 후 임상시험 등을 통한 별도의 결과보고대상 의약품의 경우에는 해당 의약품의 품목허가를 받은 자 및 의약품 도매상은 그 정보를 해당 의약품의 정기적인 최신 안전성정보 보고서 또는 시판 후 임상시험 등을 통한 별도의 결과 보고서의 제출일이 속한 분기의 종료 후 1개월 이내에 라목이 정한 방법에 따라 보고하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Notwithstanding subitem d, for pharmaceuticals subject to periodic safety update reporting under item 8 or subject to separate result reports through post-marketing clinical trials etc., the marketing authorisation holder and pharmaceutical wholesaler shall report that information, by the method in subitem d, within one month after the end of the quarter in which the submission date of the periodic safety update report or the separate result report through post-marketing clinical trials etc. falls.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Non-expedited safety information for PSUR or post-marketing study products

f.title: Submit periodic safety evaluations (signal analysis or benefit-risk) for RMP products on Form 77-4
f.statement: For products with a submitted RMP, the MAH shall periodically report to MFDS, on Form No. 77-4, the results of safety evaluation such as signal analysis, or of benefit-risk evaluation, of the safety information collected.
f.clause: 8. 정기적인 최신 안전성정보 보고 (Periodic safety update reporting), 가
f.applicability: Products with a submitted risk management plan
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Signal detection; Submission operations

rows.quote: 위해성 관리 계획을 제출한 의약품에 대하여 품목허가를 받은 자는 수집된 안전성정보에 대하여 실마리정보 분석 등 안전성 평가 또는 유익성ㆍ위해성 평가 결과를 별지 제77호의4서식에 따라 식품의약품안전처장에게 정기적으로 보고하여야 한다.
rows.location: 8. 정기적인 최신 안전성정보 보고 (Periodic safety update reporting), 가
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For a pharmaceutical for which a risk management plan has been submitted, the marketing authorisation holder shall periodically report to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety, using Form No. 77-4, the results of safety evaluation, such as signal analysis, or of benefit-risk evaluation of the safety-related information collected.

f.title: Evaluate every 6 months for 2 years, then yearly, and report within 2 months of each period
f.statement: The periodic evaluation shall be done every six months for two years from approval and annually thereafter, and results reported to MFDS within two months after each evaluation period ends. MFDS may set a different cycle depending on product type, characteristics and level of safety concern.
f.applicability: Products with a submitted risk management plan
f.exceptions: MFDS may set a different evaluation cycle

rows.deadline: Within 2 months after the end of each evaluation period
rows.quote: 가목에 따른 평가는 허가한 날부터 2년간은 6개월마다, 그 이후에는 1년마다 실시하고, 그 평가 결과는 해당 평가기간 만료 후 2개월 이내에 식품의약품안전처장에게 보고해야 한다. 다만, 식품의약품안전처장은 의약품의 종류, 특성, 안전성 또는 위해성의 정도 등을 고려해 그 평가 주기를 달리 정할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The evaluation under subitem a shall be carried out every six months for two years from the date of approval and annually thereafter, and the results shall be reported to the Minister of Food and Drug Safety within two months after the end of the evaluation period. However, the Minister of Food and Drug Safety may set a different evaluation cycle taking into account the type and characteristics of the pharmaceutical, the degree of safety or risk, and the like.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Periodic safety update reports for RMP products

f.title: Prepare one PSUR per active ingredient covering all doses and forms
f.statement: The periodic safety report shall be prepared per active ingredient and include products with different doses, dosage forms or administration methods in one report; heterogeneous routes or regimens needing separate medical evaluation are described separately.

rows.quote: 안전성 정기 보고서는 성분별로 작성한다. 투여용량, 제형, 투여방법 등이 다른 품목도 하나의 보고서에 포함하여 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 이질적인 투여경로, 용법ㆍ용량 등 의료적으로 별도의 평가가 필요한 경우에는 구분하여 기재한다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The periodic safety report shall be prepared per active ingredient. Products differing in dose, dosage form, method of administration etc. shall also be included and reported in one report. However, where separate medical evaluation is needed, such as for heterogeneous routes of administration or dosage regimens, they shall be described separately.

f.title: Separate PSURs are allowed for different indications of the same ingredient
f.statement: Pharmaceuticals with the same active ingredient but different indications may be reported in separate reports.

rows.quote: 주성분이 동일하지만 효능ㆍ효과가 다른 의약품은 별도의 보고서로 작성하여 보고할 수도 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: 할 수도 있다 = may. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Pharmaceuticals with the same active ingredient but different indications may be prepared and reported as separate reports.

f.title: Each MAH reports its own PSUR for a shared ingredient unless the RMP is shared and data use is agreed
f.statement: Where different MAHs sell products with the same active ingredient, each MAH shall submit a separate report; where the RMP is the same and data use between MAHs is permitted, the detailed content may be replaced by the other MAH's report.
f.exceptions: Same RMP and permitted data use between MAHs

rows.quote: 서로 다른 품목허가권자가 같은 주성분을 가진 의약품을 판매하는 경우에는 각각의 품목허가권자가 별도의 보고서로 보고하여야 한다. 다만, 위해성 관리 계획이 동일하고 품목허가권자 간에 자료사용이 허락된 경우에는 정기보고서의 세부내용을 상대 품목허가권자의 보고서로 갈음하여 제출할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where different marketing authorisation holders sell pharmaceuticals with the same active ingredient, each marketing authorisation holder shall report in a separate report. However, where the risk management plan is the same and use of data between the marketing authorisation holders is permitted, the detailed content of the periodic report may be replaced by the other marketing authorisation holder's report.

f.title: Treat an increase in reporting frequency of a known ADR as new information
f.statement: An increase in the reporting frequency of a known adverse drug reaction is usually regarded as new relevant information in the periodic safety report.

rows.quote: 알려진 약물이상반응의 보고 빈도가 증가하는 것은 통상적으로 새로운 관련 정보로 간주한다.
rows.review_note: Review: interpretive rule ("usually regarded"), Recommended. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: An increase in the reporting frequency of a known adverse drug reaction is usually regarded as new relevant information.

f.title: MAH may ask KIDS for spontaneous reports to include in the PSUR
f.statement: To include in the period's safety information the adverse events and ADRs spontaneously reported to KIDS, the MAH may request the President of KIDS to provide that information.

rows.quote: 보고기간 중 수집하는 안전정보에 의약품안전관리원에 자발적으로 보고된 이상사례 및 약물이상반응 정보를 포함시키기 위하여 의약품안전관리원장에게 정보의 제공을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: To include in the safety information collected in the reporting period the adverse event and adverse drug reaction information spontaneously reported to the Korea Institute of Drug Safety and Risk Management, the holder may request the President of the Institute to provide that information.

f.title: An English ICH PSUR/PBRER may be submitted with a Korean summary of the main content
f.statement: Where an English PSUR or PBRER prepared in the ICH format contains the Form 77-4 content, the MAH may submit the original with the main content written in Korean following the Form 77-4 table of contents; MFDS may require a full translation, certified by a medically or pharmaceutically qualified person, only where necessary.

rows.quote: 식품의약품안전처장은 필요한 경우에 한하여 전체 번역문(의ㆍ약학 전문지식을 갖춘 자가 그 번역의 내용이 정확함을 확인한 후 날인한 것을 말한다)을 제출하도록 할 수 있다.
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the closing sentence of 8.라; the permission to file the English ICH report with a Korean summary precedes it and is summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The Minister of Food and Drug Safety may require submission of a full translation (sealed by a person with medical or pharmaceutical expertise after confirming that the translation is accurate) only where necessary.

f.title: Submit safety data, RMPs and documents when MFDS requires them
f.statement: Where needed to confirm evaluation results for safety information, MFDS shall have the MAH submit safety-related data, risk management plans and other necessary documents.

rows.quote: 식품의약품안전처장은 의약품등의 안전성정보 평가결과의 확인 등에 필요한 경우 품목허가를 받은 자 등으로 하여금 안전성 관련 자료, 위해성 관리 계획 등 필요한 서류나 그 밖의 자료를 제출하게 하여야 한다.
rows.review_note: Review: duty framed on MFDS; the MAH must submit when required. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Where necessary to confirm the results of evaluation of safety-related information on pharmaceuticals etc., the Minister of Food and Drug Safety shall have the marketing authorisation holder etc. submit safety-related data, risk management plans and other necessary documents or data.

f.title: Record MFDS-ordered product changes on the approval certificate by the deadline
f.statement: Where MFDS orders a product change by a deadline based on safety evaluation, the manufacturer etc. shall record the date and content of the change on the back of the product approval or notification certificate by the deadline and keep it.
f.clause: 13. 품목허가증의 관리 등 (Management of product approval certificates), 가

rows.deadline: By the deadline set by MFDS
rows.quote: 정해진 기한까지 품목허가증 또는 품목신고필증 뒷면에 변경일자와 변경내용을 기재하여 보관ㆍ관리할 것
rows.location: 13. 품목허가증의 관리 등 (Management of product approval certificates), 가
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: By the set deadline, record the date and content of the change on the back of the product approval certificate or product notification certificate and keep and manage it.

f.title: Ship products with changed information and notify suppliers and the company website of ordered changes
f.statement: After the change date, all products released shall carry the changed content; for products already distributed, the suppliers (wholesalers, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies) shall be notified of the change and it shall be posted on the MAH website.

rows.quote: 변경일자 이후 출고되는 모든 제품은 변경된 내용을 첨부 또는 부착하여 유통하여야 하며, 이미 유통 중인 제품에 대하여는 당해 품목의 공급업소(도매상, 병ㆍ의원 및 약국 등)에 변경된 내용에 대한 정보를 통보하고, 이를 당해 품목허가를 받은 자의 홈페이지에 게재할 것
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Distribute all products released after the date of change with the changed content enclosed or attached, and, for products already in distribution, notify the suppliers of the product (wholesalers, hospitals and clinics, pharmacies, etc.) of the changed content and post it on the website of the marketing authorisation holder.
